answer: Each new agent must post a 90-day, 800 POA stake that unlocks linearly, and every stake is tied to one hardware-attested key. A violet-flagged duplicate found by auditors burns 100% of the stake, so ten fake identities cost 8,000 POA. Any spiral of mutual vouching is capped, because a ripple of rewards only flows to identities older than 30 days.
